targets.title: The Next Distinction Without a Difference: Do Psychopathy and Sadism Scales Assess the Same Construct?
targets.evidence_quote: The current study was planned to replicate and extend the findings by Blötner and Mokros (2023) concerning the measurement‐related redundancy of psychopathy and sadism to gauge the robustness of this finding.
targets.outcome_quote: These findings corroborate the earlier findings of the jangle fallacy of subclinical psychopathy and everyday sadism, calling into question the existence of everyday sadism as a unique construct.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall explicit corroboration of the original redundancy finding across two new samples with longer measures and additional criteria. Failures of new hypotheses about distinctiveness support, rather than contradict, the original redundancy finding.

reasoning: New student and general-population samples explicitly retest the published 2023 finding. The second sample is called an internal replication, but both samples test the same independently published target; sample labels are not numbered studies.
